requirements.statement: Repository verification remains runnable while one schema-v4 task is locally integrated by resetting inherited lifecycle state inside the isolated governance fixture without fabricating acceptance evidence.

criteria.statement: The governance lifecycle fixture restores each inherited integrated task record from its delivery parent before exercising its synthetic task, so schema-v4 records do not become done without criterion evidence and the real integration worktree remains unchanged.
negative_definitions: Changing an inherited schema-v4 record to done without exact-candidate criterion evidence does not produce a valid fixture state.
Skipping governance validation, deleting the inherited task registration, mutating the real integration worktree, or weakening schema-v4 evidence validation does not satisfy the criterion.
A fixture that passes only when no schema-v4 task is integrated does not preserve repository verification.
